pages.text: Digests $(l)Biomass$() into $(l)Biogas$(). It runs on $(l)8 FE/t$(): feed it from a $(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass Press$(/l) and connect an $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l) to the machine block. It takes Speed, Efficiency and Battery $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) on the tab beside its GUI.

It takes $(l)2 Cyber Frames$(), one above it and one on its left as you face it. Right-click it alone and drones show where they go. Once complete, the upper drum rises and a tank slides out beside it, its sight glass showing the gas. It doesn't work until then; breaking a frame folds it back.

$(li)Accepts only $(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass$(/l).$(br)$(li)Each Biomass takes 2 seconds and gives $(l)250 mB$() of Biogas.$(br)$(li)Holds $(l)8,000 mB$() and pushes the gas into adjacent $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipes$(/l), tanks or a $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l). Pipes connect to the machine block, on its free sides.
A Harvester drone, a hopper into a $(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass Press$(/l) and the press's nozzle pointing at the digester make a fully automatic biogas farm.
